name: Rhizosphere
desc: A cutaway of living soil packed with root — several plants drive multiple primary axes down through the O, A, B and C horizons hunting water, laterals fanning off to a fourth order until the profile is a dense mat, root hairs and mycorrhizal fuzz hazing every tip, while rain fronts visibly percolate downward through crumb aggregates and pores and generations germinate and senesce.

energy.doc: root extension rate, hydrotropic sensitivity and exposure

density.doc: how many plants contend for the profile (2-7), mycorrhizal fuzz and the strength of the moisture wash

speed.doc: rate of growth, ageing and the climate cycle

scale.doc: root thickness and the hydrotropic sensing distance

y.doc: the soil surface — where roots start

branch.doc: lateral branching rate — a bare taproot to a dense fibrous mat

act.doc: cycle: rain comes and goes on the section arc · monsoon: constant percolation, roots race · drought: the profile dries and roots die back from the tips

style.doc: soil_profile: the pedological cutaway, warm horizons and aggregate · xray: radiograph, roots as transmitted density on near-black · cyanotype: blueprint contact print · ink: dark line on a pale field, no tone
